items.name: Sagnik Chandra
items.current_activity: I am based in Kolkata, India, currently pursuing an M.Sc. in Data Science & Artificial Intelligence at RKMVERI Belur, focusing on Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing, and Distributed Systems.
items.summary: Driven by deep learning and mathematical rigor, I build high-throughput ML pipelines and research context retrieval in neural architectures.
paragraphs: My focus in Artificial Intelligence stems from a deep curiosity about how neural networks process context and attention. I specialize in building scalable machine learning systems and exploring context retrieval architectures.

Beyond core model evaluation, I actively build with modern AI paradigms including Model Context Protocol (MCP), LangChain, PyTorch, and distributed PySpark & Neo4j graph pipelines, bridging theoretical mathematics with production systems.
Outside of research papers and terminal windows, I am a passionate reader of Modern & Medieval History and behavioral Psychology. I am also a competitive chess player and dedicated gamer.
